thread:
nora evans: quick sync note — we need a concrete default for the continuous-batcher. tradeoffs: prioritize latency (speculative tiny batches) or density (coalesce aggressively). microburst-heavy apps keep surfacing this.
omar khalid: density by default, express/small-batch as opt-in per-route. lots of tenants care about unit cost & kv stability.
faye wong: agree default dense, but expose two simple knobs: latency_target_ms and cost_tolerance (low/med/high). runtime maps to admission + priority weighting.
nora evans: runtime mapping proposal sketch:
```
if latency_target_ms <= 140:
  enable_speculative = true
  speculative_budget_tokens_per_min = min(1000, tokens_from_SLO)
  priority_weight(speculative) = 0.9
else:
  enable_speculative = false
  soft_min_batch = 8
  coalesce_window_ms = 20
```
omar khalid: important: speculative tiny batches fragment kv-cache. we saw kv_hit_ratio drop ~12% on a mixed-workload canary when express=true.
ops-bot: ALERT: canary-92: batcher.kv_hit_ratio down 11% in last 7m
faye wong: reaction: add auto-disable rules: if kv_hit_ratio_delta < -8% for 5m OR gpu_seconds_per_token > threshold, disable speculative for the route and notify. Also add decay to speculative budget so spikes don't permanently exhaust it.
omar khalid: operational improvement: use admission weights instead of forcing tiny-batch path. speculative requests get higher admission priority but can still join larger coalesced batches if present. that preserves some locality.
nora evans: good idea. call it priority_score in [0..1], starts high for express traffic and decays with wait_time. config example:
```
speculative.priority_score_start = 0.95
speculative.decay_ms = 150
soft_min_batch = 4  # soft with hysteresis
```
faye wong: telemetry we must ship before wide rollout: per-route batch_size_histogram, wait_time_p95, kv_hit_ratio, speculative_tokens_used, gpu_seconds_per_token. these let auto-disable be signal-driven.
ops-bot: NOTE: deploy-bot rolled canary-92 express=true at 1745556000
omar khalid: action items: nora draft RFC with mapping table + auto-disable thresholds; faye run kv-sim to estimate hit-ratio impact and produce charts; i'll build a small sim to evaluate priority-weight admission. timeline: RFC draft Wed EOD, review Thurs.
nora evans: will also add a Console flag force-mode=(auto|express|dense) and a small dashboard tile batch_size_vs_kv_hit to help SREs.
faye wong: will paste sim outputs here when done. if auto-disable flips too often, we need hysteresis on auto-disable (cooldown window).
omar khalid: agreed. closing until RFC posted. :thumbsup:
